High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Order 
This is the third bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023/ 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.64 of 2024 registered at Police Station - Singrauli, District - Singrauli (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(3) and 506 of the IPC and Section 3/4(2) of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 26.06.2024.

2. Earlier two bail applications i.e. M.Cr.C. No.47347/2024 and M.Cr.C. No.4136/2025 were dismissed as withdrawn vide orders dated 17.12.2024 and 06.02.2025 respectively.
3.

Learned counsel for applicant has submitted that the age of the victim is highly doubtful as the birth certificate was issued by the CHC, Khutar, Sidhi whereas at that time Singrauli was a separate district.

There are material contradictions in the statement of the victim as it is alleged that NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:43014 2 MCRC-12826-2025 the applicant kidnapped the victim alone and she did not make in cry for help, that is unnatural, hence, the applicant be released on bail.
4. Learned counsel for State has opposed the bail application and has submitted that the DNA report has been received and that is positive.
Victim was minor at the time of offence, hence, the applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.

5. Heard the parties and perused the case diary.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per the birth certificate is concerned, it was issued by the CHC, Khutar and the name of the district and tehsil is clearly written Singrauli, only in the seal, the name of district is written as Sidhi and the birth was registered on 19.06.2010 and date of birth is also 19.06.2010.
Birth certificate was issued on 20.08.2010 much the before the incident.
Looking to this fact, school record and DNA report, no case of bail is made out, hence, this bail application is dismissed.
7. Accordingly, Misc. Criminal Case stands disposed of.

(DEVNARAYAN MISHRA) JUDGE DPS Santosh @ Rajendra Saket vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17711058/
